title: Combinatorial construction of known positive series for partition classes defined by Capparelli, Meurman, Primc, and Primc in the $k$=1 Case
summary: Recently, Capparelli, Meurman, A. Primc and M. Primc introduced a class of colored partitions which has since been called CMPP partitions. This generalized earlier work by M. Primc and Šikić, and by Trupčević. One main reason why CMPP partitions are significant is the authors' conjecture that the generating functions are infinite products in all cases. CMPP partitions are true extensions of the partition classes in the Rogers-Ramanujan-Gordon identities which are defined by difference conditions.
